content: You are not in the world. The world is in you.
Wisdom tells me I am nothing. Love tells me I am everything. Between the two my life flows.
What you are looking for is what is looking.
Sitting quietly, doing nothing, spring comes, and the grass grows by itself.
To study the way is to study the self. To study the self is to forget the self.
If you cannot find the truth right where you are, where else do you expect to find it?
Turn attention back to its source. What is looking?
Awareness is not an experience. It is that which experiences.
No one becomes enlightened. Our being is simply relieved of an imaginary limitation.
You are the sky. Everything else is just the weather.
The primary task of any good spiritual teaching is not to answer your questions, but to question your answers.
Wake up or perish is the spiritual call of our times.
The path home is zero steps long.
What is here when you stop adding to this moment?
